Get user combo activity
pages.description: Combo lifecycle and redeem events (split / merge / convert / compress / wrap / unwrap / redeem) for a user, with per-leg breakdown. The combo counterpart to /activity trade rows. Also available at /v1/data/user/{address}/activity/combos (address from the path).

pages.title: Get user combo positions
pages.description: Combinatorial (multi-market) positions held by a user, with per-leg breakdown. Also available at /v1/data/user/{address}/positions/combos (address from the path).

pages.title: Get midpoint price
pages.description: Retrieves the midpoint price for a specific token ID. The midpoint is calculated as the average of the best bid and best ask prices.

pages.title: Get server time
pages.description: Returns the current Unix timestamp of the server. This can be used to synchronize client time with server time.

pages.title: List events (keyset pagination)
pages.description: Returns events using cursor-based (keyset) pagination for stable, efficient paging through large result sets. Use `next_cursor` from each response as `after_cursor` in the next request. The `offset` parameter is explicitly rejected; use `after_cursor` instead.

pages.title: Introduction
pages.description: Overview of the Polymarket APIs

pages.title: Cancel a quote
pages.description: Cancel an active maker quote before it is selected. Requires CLOB L2 authentication for the maker role. `signer_address` and `maker_address` must match the authenticated identity.

pages.title: Confirm or decline last look
pages.description: Respond to a last-look confirmation request for a selected quote. Requires CLOB L2 authentication for the maker role. `decision` must be `CONFIRM` or `DECLINE`.

pages.title: Submit a quote
pages.description: Submit a signed maker quote for an active RFQ. Requires CLOB L2 authentication for the maker role.

pages.title: Get fee rate
pages.description: Retrieves the base fee rate for a specific token ID. The fee rate can be provided either as a query parameter or as a path parameter.

pages.title: Get fee rate by path parameter
pages.description: Retrieves the base fee rate for a specific token ID using the token ID as a path parameter.

pages.title: Get last trade price
pages.description: Retrieves the last trade price and side for a specific token ID. Returns default values of "0.5" for price and empty string for side if no trades found.

pages.title: Get last trade prices (query parameters)
pages.description: Retrieves last trade prices for multiple token IDs using query parameters. Maximum 500 token IDs can be requested per call.

pages.title: Get last trade prices (request body)
pages.description: Retrieves last trade prices for multiple token IDs using a request body. Maximum 500 token IDs can be requested per call.

pages.title: Get market price
pages.description: Retrieves the best market price for a specific token ID and side (bid or ask). Returns the best bid price for BUY side or best ask price for SELL side.

pages.title: Get market prices (query parameters)
pages.description: Retrieves market prices for multiple token IDs and sides using query parameters.

pages.title: Get market prices (request body)
pages.description: Retrieves market prices for multiple token IDs and sides using a request body. Each request must include both token_id and side.

pages.title: Get midpoint prices (query parameters)
pages.description: Retrieves midpoint prices for multiple token IDs using query parameters. The midpoint is calculated as the average of the best bid and best ask prices.

pages.title: Get midpoint prices (request body)
pages.description: Retrieves midpoint prices for multiple token IDs using a request body. The midpoint is calculated as the average of the best bid and best ask prices.

pages.title: Get order book
pages.description: Retrieves the order book summary for a specific token ID. Includes bids, asks, market details, and last trade price.

pages.title: Get order books (request body)
pages.description: Retrieves order book summaries for multiple token IDs using a request body.

pages.title: Get spread
pages.description: Retrieves the spread for a specific token ID. The spread is the difference between the best ask and best bid prices.

pages.title: Get spreads
pages.description: Retrieves spreads for multiple token IDs. The spread is the difference between the best ask and best bid prices.

pages.title: Get tick size
pages.description: Retrieves the minimum tick size (price increment) for a specific token ID. The tick size can be provided either as a query parameter or as a path parameter.

pages.title: Get tick size by path parameter
pages.description: Retrieves the minimum tick size (price increment) for a specific token ID using the token ID as a path parameter.

pages.title: Get batch prices history
pages.description: Retrieve historical price data for multiple markets in a single request.

pages.title: Get CLOB market info
pages.description: Returns all CLOB-level parameters for a market in a single call — tokens, tick size, base fees, rewards, RFQ status, and fee details.

pages.title: Get market by token
pages.description: Returns the parent market for a given token ID. Useful when you have a token ID and need to resolve its parent market without knowing the condition ID in advance.

pages.title: Get prices history
pages.description: Retrieve historical price data for a market.

pages.title: List markets (keyset pagination)
pages.description: Returns markets using cursor-based (keyset) pagination for stable, efficient paging through large result sets. Use `next_cursor` from each response as `after_cursor` in the next request. The `offset` parameter is explicitly rejected; use `after_cursor` instead.

pages.title: Get current rebated fees for a maker
pages.description: Returns the current rebated fees for a maker address on a given date.

pages.title: Get all relayer API keys
pages.description: Returns all relayer API keys for the authenticated address. Auth allowed: Gamma auth or Relayer API key auth (`RELAYER_API_KEY` + `RELAYER_API_KEY_ADDRESS`).

pages.title: Check if a wallet is deployed
pages.description: Returns whether the wallet at the given address is deployed onchain.

pages.title: Get a transaction by ID
pages.description: Gets a transaction submitted to the Relayer. Takes in a required transaction ID as a query parameter.

pages.title: Get current nonce for a user
pages.description: Gets the current Proxy or Safe nonce for a user. Takes in the user's signer address and the type of nonce to retrieve.

pages.title: Get recent transactions for a user
pages.description: Gets the most recent transactions submitted to the Relayer, owned by a specific user. Authenticated using Builder API Keys or Relayer API Keys.

pages.title: Get relayer address and nonce
pages.description: Fetches the relayer address and nonce for a specific user. Takes in the user's signer address and the type of nonce to retrieve.

pages.title: Submit a transaction
pages.description: Submit a transaction request to the Relayer. Authenticated using Builder API Keys or Relayer API Keys.

pages.title: Get current active rewards configurations
pages.description: Returns all current active rewards configurations grouped by market.

pages.title: Get earnings for user by date
pages.description: Returns an array of user earnings per market for a provided day.

pages.title: Get multiple markets with rewards
pages.description: Returns a list of active markets with their reward configurations. Supports text search, tag filtering, numeric filters, and sorting.

pages.title: Get raw rewards for a specific market
pages.description: Returns an array of present and future rewards configured on a market.

pages.title: Get reward percentages for user
pages.description: Returns the real-time percentages of rewards that a user is earning per market.

pages.title: Get total earnings for user by date
pages.description: Returns the summed total rewards earnings for a user on a provided day, grouped by asset address.

pages.title: Get user earnings and markets configuration
pages.description: Returns an array of current rewards including user earnings and live percentages per market for a provided day.

Cancel all orders
pages.description: Cancels all open orders for the authenticated user. Works even in cancel-only mode.

pages.title: Cancel multiple orders
pages.description: Cancels multiple orders by their IDs. Maximum 1000 orders per request. Duplicate order IDs in the request are automatically ignored. Works even in cancel-only mode.

pages.title: Cancel orders for a market
pages.description: Cancels all open orders for the authenticated user in a specific market (condition) and asset. Works even in cancel-only mode.

pages.title: Cancel single order
pages.description: Cancels a single order by its ID. Works even in cancel-only mode.

pages.title: Get builder trades
pages.description: Retrieves trades attributed to a builder code.

pages.title: Get order scoring status
pages.description: Checks if a specific order is currently scoring for rewards.

pages.title: Get single order by ID
pages.description: Retrieves a specific order by its ID (order hash) for the authenticated user. Builder-authenticated clients can also use this endpoint to retrieve orders attributed to their builder account.

pages.title: Get trades
pages.description: Retrieves trades for the authenticated user. Returns paginated results. Requires readonly or level 2 API key authentication.

pages.title: Get user orders
pages.description: Retrieves open orders for the authenticated user. Returns paginated results. Builder-authenticated clients can also use this endpoint to retrieve orders attributed to their builder account.

pages.title: Post a new order
pages.description: Creates a new order in the order book

pages.title: Post multiple orders
pages.description: Creates multiple new orders in the order book. Orders are processed in parallel. Maximum 15 orders per request.

pages.title: Send heartbeat
pages.description: Sends a heartbeat signal to maintain active session status. If heartbeats are not sent regularly, all open orders for the user will be automatically canceled. This is useful for automated trading systems that need to ensure orders are canceled if the system becomes unresponsive.
